indications: YUVEZZI™ is indicated for the treatment of presbyopia in adults.
contraindications: Instill one drop in each eye once daily. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
YUVEZZI (carbachol and brimonidine tartrate ophthalmic solution) 2.75% / 0.1% is supplied as a clear, greenish-yellow ophthalmic solution in a low-density polyethylene (LDPE) single-dose vial, as follows:
                  
                     
                     
                     
                        
                           Carton box of 30 single-dose vials (6 pouches each containing 5 vials)
                           NDC 84892-275-30
adverseReactions: YUVEZZI is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to the active ingredients or to any of the excipients.
name: YUVEZZI
